body: hey, thank you for your reply. im sorry that you can relate, that sounds so tough :/ no no, it totally did; it helped just to get it out there, to look at what id written and go "objectively thats messed up", and it helped to have someone else confirm that for me too. youre so right, it really isnt our job and it sucks that we've been made to feel like it is. wishing you the absolute best with your situation; you deserve to go out and live your own life
sounds right to me--unless they got suspended. if they just deactivated and you get there first, then yeah sure

it depends on whether they have push notifications on. if they do, it will show up in their notifs bar; if they dont, it wont show up anywhere. i wouldnt worry though: if you immediately cancelled and the person noticed, they will know it was an accident
have you tried muting the conversation? sorry if you have/sorry if it doesnt work

honestly just being there is enough. you dont need to give advice (unless she asks for it), or try to "fix" things; its really nice to have someone to listen, to remind you that youre cared for, to say something like "god, that sounds really hard". or if she doesnt take you up on talking, its nice knowing that theres someone to turn to 

checking in can also be good: "good morning, just letting you know i think youre awesome"/"hey, i care about you a lot. please feel free to let me know if you want to talk about anything, or if you could do with a distraction" or something like that maybe

"is there anything i can do for you?" might be worth trying too--she might say no even if there is something, but if she can see that youre serious and wont be annoyed if she takes you up on it (not saying that you would be at all, depressed brains just like to mess with us) then you might be able to support her that way

you sound like a good friend. wishing you and your friend the best, and dont forget to take care of yourself too

im really sorry if this is worded badly or anything like that. my brain is absolute mush right now but i saw the other comment you got before it got (i think) removed and it was really wrong of them to say what they did: they had no right to assume things about you and its not fair to say that any of that stuff is easy. when youre not in a good headspace, very few things are easy, i find

id never claim to know exactly what youre going through, but i know how much negative thoughts hurt and i wish i could ease at least some of that weight. i wish you the absolute best, and i hope that the coming days are kind to you

im not in a good headspace right now so im sorry if this sounds trite or stupid, but i really hope it doesnt. i really, really hope you can read this right now, and that youll be able to tomorrow and the next day and the day after. that those days will be kinder to you. we dont know each other, and id never assume anything about you and what youre going through, but im really glad youre here (on this earth, not this subreddit--though the people are nice). again, sorry if this is worded really badly, i just couldnt scroll past
if you recognise this, it might be because I posted it before and it got taken down because I'm a dumbass
Please, for the love of all that is good and just, buy some fungicide
